capabilities.justification: Collects bounded passphrase, item-password, and echoed item-metadata bytes from the controlling terminal instead of redirectable process stdin.
Reads one encrypted regular-file artifact under exact metadata and streaming byte ceilings before application authentication.
Writes fixed secret and item-field prompts plus post-secret newlines directly to the controlling terminal.
Creates and synchronizes only an already-encrypted portable artifact with create-new semantics and never replaces an existing final path.

capabilities.target: Unix termios and Windows console APIs
capabilities.justification: Verifies the native terminal object and disables and restores input echo using platform APIs unavailable through portable Rust I/O.

capabilities.target: operating-system cryptographic random source via rust/csprng
capabilities.justification: Fills caller-owned initialization and encryption randomness without a user-space or deterministic fallback.
Detects which desktop clipboard family this session has, so a headless host fails closed instead of silently succeeding. Nothing is spawned and no clipboard is read during detection.
Probes for a clipboard utility in two root-owned directories only. PATH is never consulted, so a caller-controlled directory cannot supply the program a secret is written to.

capabilities.target: pbcopy, pbpaste, wl-copy, wl-paste, xclip, xsel
capabilities.justification: Writes, reads back, and clears the platform clipboard through pre-installed utilities with fixed compile-time argument vectors. The secret is written to the utility's standard input and never appears in argv, where ps would publish it to every account on the host.

Re-executes the running binary as a detached process that performs the configured timed clipboard clear, which a one-shot CLI cannot otherwise outlive. It receives a delay, a random salt, and a SHA-256 commitment on a pipe, never the copied value and never an argument.

A second fork orphans the clearer to init and setsid detaches it from the terminal session, so a long-lived interactive shell accumulates no zombies and closing the terminal window does not cancel a pending clear.

capabilities.target: the detached clipboard clearer and spawned clipboard utilities
capabilities.justification: Arms alarm(delay + 30) in the clearer and kills any clipboard utility that exceeds a five-second bound, so no clipboard path can hang a terminal or leave a resident process.

Only the detached clearer reads standard input, and only a fixed-length block of a delay, a salt, and a commitment. No passphrase, record secret, or copied value is ever read from standard input; VLT-PM08's rule is unchanged.
The detached clearer waits the configured timeout before verifying and clearing the clipboard.

justification: CLI-only host boundary for non-redirectable bounded terminal input, fresh operating-system entropy, create-new persistence of an already-encrypted portable artifact, and clipboard delivery with a verified timed clear. Clipboard access spawns only pre-installed platform utilities with fixed argument vectors and this same executable, always passing secret-derived material on a pipe rather than in argv; it performs no configuration, provider, or network access.
